name: basic
description: Floe basic Linux guest: the 13 user-facing shell commands from the Build 225 feedback report plus Python 3 (pip/venv/numpy), Node.js/npm and HTTPS trust. This is the package set FloeAgent/LinuxGuest/image/guest-stage1-install.sh installs for the default image; every requirement is independently re-verified against the live dpkg database during boot B of the image build.
